alerts.title: TSMC Q1 Earnings Today (BMO)
alerts.text: Taiwan Semiconductor reports before the open today. Revenue +35% YoY already confirmed. AI chip demand trajectory is THE metric — validates or challenges the entire Nasdaq rally thesis. SMH, AVGO, MRVL, CRDO all directly exposed. Watch for Arizona/Japan fab commentary and forward guidance.

intro: 🟢 RISK-ON Confirmed — VIX at 17.94 (sub-18), SPX 7,041 near ATH, Nasdaq 11-day win streak. Bank earnings crushed (JPM +13% profit, Citi net income +42%). PPI March came in at +0.5% vs +1.1% est — biggest downside surprise in months. Oil retreating to $89.63 on Iran de-escalation. TSMC reports today BMO — the semis super-cycle validation event.
strategy: We concentrate on three high-conviction themes: (1) Semiconductor super-cycle — TSMC reports today, SMH at 52-week high, AVGO/MRVL/CRDO ride the AI chip wave; (2) Bank earnings momentum — MS near 52-week high after JPM/Citi crushed, wealth management tailwind; (3) Global rotation — EWY (Korea semis proxy), EWG (German industrials on fiscal stimulus), KWEB (China internet value), RACE (EU luxury). Suite aux rétrospectives (note C*), nous favorisons Momentum et Breakout qui montrent les meilleurs hit rates historiques.
regime_prose: The regime score stands at 0.48, classified as RISK-ON. Component scores: VIX 1.0 (sub-18, maximum bullish), SPX 0.53 (above 50 & 200 DMA), Credit 0.58 (HYG stable), DXY 0.50 (dollar weak at 98.21 supporting multinationals), TLT 0.66, Liquidity 0.62. pedagogy.title: Why Semis Lead in RISK-ON Regimes
pedagogy.content: Semiconductors are the quintessential RISK-ON sector. When VIX drops below 20 and credit spreads normalize, capital rotates from defensive plays (utilities, staples, gold) into high-beta growth. Semis sit at the intersection of three mega-trends: (1) AI infrastructure spending (TSMC, AVGO, MRVL), (2) global tech capex cycle (data centers, cloud), and (3) dollar weakness (most semi companies derive 50-80% of revenue internationally). The SMH ETF at its 52-week high today is the clearest confirmation of this rotation. Historically, when SMH breaks to new highs in a RISK-ON regime, it continues for 2-4 weeks before mean-reversion. This is why we have 5 of our 10 setups directly or indirectly tied to the semiconductor supply chain.

macro_thesis: Three converging catalysts define today’s setup universe: (1) TSMC earnings — the single most important data point for AI infrastructure. Revenue +35% YoY already confirmed, but guidance and Arizona fab timelines will set the direction for the entire semi complex (AVGO, MRVL, CRDO, SMH). (2) Bank earnings afterglow — JPM profit +13%, Citi net income +42%, PPI surprise to downside (+0.5% vs +1.1%) all confirm the disinflation + earnings strength narrative. MS near 52-week high is the cleanest financial play. (3) Global diversification — DXY at 98.21 (weak dollar) boosts international earnings. EWY benefits from Samsung/SK Hynix semi exposure, EWG from German fiscal stimulus, RACE from European luxury resilience, KWEB from China internet value at multi-year lows.

setups.name: Broadcom Inc.
setups.thesis: Broadcom is the highest-conviction AI infrastructure play heading into TSMC earnings today. As the #2 custom AI chip designer (behind NVIDIA) and the dominant networking chip provider for hyperscaler data centers, AVGO directly benefits from any TSMC guidance beat. The stock trades at $398 — above both 50-DMA ($331) and 200-DMA ($333) — with forward PE of 22x, cheap relative to the AI growth embedded in the VMware + custom ASIC pipeline. TSMC’s +35% YoY revenue growth validates the demand environment. Oil dropping below $90 removes the inflation headwind that had been compressing tech multiples.
confirmations: TSMC Q1 revenue +35% YoY — validates AI chip demand directly impacting AVGO custom silicon orders
Price above 50-DMA ($331) AND 200-DMA ($333) — strong technical uptrend confirmation
Forward PE 22x is below 5-year average of 28x — valuation discount despite AI tailwinds
VMware integration on track — $4B+ annual synergies beginning to flow through Q2 guidance
DXY at 98.21 (weak) — >60% international revenue benefits from dollar depreciation
invalidations: TSMC guidance miss or soft AI chip commentary would undercut the entire thesis
Break below $378 (50-DMA proximity) signals momentum failure — exit immediately
Oil reversal above $95 reignites inflation fears and compresses tech multiples
Tariff escalation on semiconductor equipment (Section 301 comments deadline passed April 15)

setups.name: Credo Technology Group
setups.description: AI Networking / High-Speed Connectivity • NASDAQ • $29.3B mcap
setups.thesis: Credo Technology pulled back -5.6% Wednesday offering a rare entry into one of the strongest AI networking names. CRDO provides the high-speed connectivity solutions (Active Electrical Cables, SerDes IP) that connect GPUs in AI data centers — the “plumbing” of AI infrastructure. With 52-week range of $33–$214, the stock at $159 sits in a pullback zone after a parabolic run. TSMC earnings today are a direct catalyst: if TSMC confirms AI chip demand acceleration, networking interconnect demand (CRDO’s core) follows. Forward PE of 33.5x is elevated but justified by 80%+ revenue growth trajectory.
confirmations: Revenue growth trajectory 80%+ YoY — fastest growth in the semiconductor supply chain
Pullback from $214 to $159 (-26%) creates a better risk/reward entry vs chasing highs
AI data center interconnect TAM expanding from $3B to $15B by 2028 (management guidance)
TSMC earnings today = direct catalyst for AI infrastructure spending validation
50-DMA at $115 provides deep support — current price well above trend
invalidations: TSMC guidance miss on AI chip demand would directly hit networking interconnect expectations
Break below $142 signals the pullback is becoming a trend reversal — exit immediately
Customer concentration risk — top 3 customers represent >60% of revenue
Elevated forward PE (33.5x) leaves no room for execution miss in upcoming quarterly report

setups.name: Morgan Stanley
setups.description: Investment Banking / Wealth Management • NYSE • $297B mcap
setups.thesis: Morgan Stanley sits near its 52-week high ($194.59) after a -2.24% pullback Wednesday, offering a breakout re-entry. The bank earnings season has been spectacular: JPM profit +13%, Citi net income +42%, GS blowout. MS is the most wealth-management-heavy of the bulge brackets, with $7.6T in client assets making it less cyclical than pure IB plays. The stock pulled back after reporting — likely profit-taking after a strong run. Forward PE of 15x is attractive for a franchise this dominant. The PPI downside surprise (+0.5% vs +1.1%) supports rate cut expectations, which benefits MS’s fixed income AUM.
confirmations: JPM profit +13%, Citi net income +42% — sector earnings momentum is overwhelming
Near 52-week high ($194.59) — breakout territory with strong technical setup
Forward PE 15x is below historical average of 17x for MS — valuation support
PPI surprise to downside (+0.5% vs +1.1%) supports rate cut expectations, benefiting wealth management AUM
$7.6T in client assets provides recurring revenue stability vs pure trading desks

Rising credit defaults or HYG weakness signals credit stress ahead
Regulatory action or capital requirement changes from Fed/OCC

setups.name: Meta Platforms Inc.
setups.description: AI / Digital Advertising / Social • NASDAQ • $1.71T mcap
setups.thesis: Meta Platforms combines two powerful narratives: AI infrastructure leadership and digital advertising dominance. The stock at $677 trades at forward PE of 19x — remarkably cheap for a company growing revenue 20%+ with 35%+ operating margins. Meta’s Llama 4 AI model and $65B capex plan for 2026 position it as the scale AI infrastructure play alongside NVDA. The TSMC earnings catalyst today validates the AI chip demand environment that underpins Meta’s capex spending. Historically, META is one of the few stocks where TimesFM directional accuracy exceeds 75%, making this a high-confidence momentum play. Q1 earnings report April 23 is the next major catalyst.
confirmations: Forward PE 19x for 20%+ revenue growth — cheapest mega-cap tech on a PEG basis
Llama 4 AI model + $65B 2026 capex plan — credible path to AI monetization
50-DMA at $629 provides strong technical support — current price well above trend
Q1 earnings April 23 — historically beats by 10-15% with post-earnings drift
Digital ad market resilient despite tariff fears — no sign of advertiser pullback
invalidations: Q1 earnings miss on April 23 would create a -10%+ gap down given elevated expectations
Break below $648 signals momentum failure ahead of earnings — exit to avoid binary risk
Antitrust action from FTC/DOJ escalation would compress the multiple
AI capex returns questioned by analysts — any $65B capex skepticism is a headwind

setups.name: Marvell Technology Inc.
setups.description: Custom AI Silicon / Data Center • NASDAQ • $116.6B mcap
setups.thesis: Marvell Technology is within 4% of its 52-week high ($138.19), signaling a potential breakout. As the #3 custom AI chip designer (behind NVDA and AVGO), MRVL is the highest-beta pure-play on AI data center infrastructure. The stock has rallied from $48 to $133 over the past year — a 177% move driven entirely by AI custom silicon wins with Amazon, Google, and Microsoft. TSMC earnings today are the catalyst: TSMC’s advanced packaging (CoWoS) capacity directly determines how many custom AI chips MRVL can deliver. Forward PE of 24.6x reflects high growth expectations but the 50%+ revenue growth trajectory supports it.
confirmations: Within 4% of 52-week high ($138.19) — breakout setup with momentum behind it
50-DMA at $93 and 200-DMA at $84 — massively above both, strong uptrend
Custom AI silicon wins with Amazon (Trainium), Google (TPU), Microsoft — diversified customer base
TSMC CoWoS capacity expansion directly benefits MRVL custom chip delivery timeline
Revenue growth trajectory 50%+ YoY with improving operating leverage
invalidations: Failure to break above $138 (52-week high) would create a double-top pattern — bearish
TSMC soft guidance on advanced packaging capacity directly limits MRVL revenue potential
Break below $122 (stop) signals the rally is exhausted — exit immediately
Customer concentration — any single hyperscaler pullback impacts 30%+ of revenue

setups.name: Ferrari N.V.
setups.thesis: Ferrari is the ultimate pricing-power play in European luxury. With average selling price >$350K, demand far exceeds supply (10,000+ unit waitlist), and the brand is effectively tariff-immune — wealthy buyers absorb any price increase. RACE at $357 is recovering from its 52-week low zone ($312) with 50-DMA at $349 providing immediate support. Forward PE of 28x reflects premium quality but is below the 5-year average of 35x due to broader market de-rating. European luxury (LVMH, Hermès) is showing resilience while US consumer discretionary weakens — a quality rotation tailwind. The weak DXY ($98.21) benefits Euro-denominated revenue translation.

Tariff-immune positioning — luxury buyers absorb cost, unlike mass market auto

European luxury sector resilient (LVMH, Hermes outperforming) vs US consumer discretionary

Broader risk-off event compresses luxury multiples faster than defensive sectors

setups.name: iShares MSCI South Korea ETF
setups.description: Korean Equities ETF • NYSE Arca • $11.1B AUM
setups.thesis: EWY is the best Asia proxy for the semiconductor super-cycle. The ETF is dominated by Samsung Electronics (~25%) and SK Hynix (~10%) — together representing 35% of the fund. At $147.47, EWY is within 5% of its 52-week high ($154.22) and has rallied from $54 over the past year (+173%). TSMC earnings today are a direct catalyst: strong AI chip demand validates the Korean memory and foundry supply chain. Samsung’s HBM3E ramp for NVIDIA and SK Hynix’s AI memory dominance mean EWY is effectively an AI memory beta play. The weak won and DXY support Korean exporter earnings.

setups.name: VanEck Semiconductor ETF
setups.thesis: SMH closed at $454.80 — within $2.29 of its all-time high ($457.09). This is the cleanest semiconductor breakout setup in the market. The ETF holds TSMC (14%), NVDA (12%), AVGO (8%), ASML (5%), and MRVL — concentrated AI/semiconductor exposure. TSMC reporting BMO today is the binary catalyst: a guidance beat pushes SMH through the ATH, triggering momentum buyers and systematic breakout strategies. The ETF has rallied from $184 to $455 over 12 months (+147%). Breakout above $457 opens measured move to $500+. Risk/reward is asymmetric: breakout = acceleration, failure = modest pullback to $435 support.

TSMC earnings BMO today is the binary catalyst for the breakout trigger
50-DMA at $404 and 200-DMA at $351 — massively above both, confirmed uptrend

setups.name: KraneShares CSI China Internet ETF
setups.description: China Internet ETF • NYSE Arca • Tencent, Alibaba, PDD, JD, Meituan
setups.thesis: KWEB at $30.10 represents deep value in Chinese internet — the ETF holds Tencent, Alibaba, PDD, JD.com, Meituan at forward PE of 15x vs US tech at 25x+. The Trump-Xi summit scheduled May 14-15 is the macro catalyst: any tariff de-escalation rhetoric directly benefits Chinese internet names that derive revenue domestically (not from US exports). China Q1 GDP released this week provides a demand read. The ETF is near multi-year lows, creating asymmetric upside: 30% to 52-week high vs 8% to stop. PBOC has room for monetary easing if GDP disappoints, providing a floor. Technically, the stock is consolidating at 50-DMA ($30.49).
